generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Pre-qualification conditions are explained in tender booklet. Interested bidders shall abide by the rules and conditions mentioned in the standard tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

We hereby declare that we have carefully read, fully understood, and unconditionally accept and agree to all the general conditions, statutory regulations, labor welfare rules, safety requirements, and procedural instructions specified in the tender document page number 6 to 9.

technicalCriterionList.description: The prospective bidder should have satisfactorily completed, as a prime Contractor, at least one similar nature of work, namely maintenance /repair of Gantry/EOT crane works of value not less than Rs 8.34 lakhs (including GST) in any reputed Industry/PSU/Government Organization during the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).In proof of the above, the bidder shall submit the Work Completion Certificate along with the corresponding Work Order issued by the competent authority. In the case of Central Government/State Government/Government Undertakings, the certificate shall be issued by an officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent, and in the case of KPCL, by an officer not below the rank of Chief Engineer.
Agency shall upload work order pertaining to the work done certificate uploaded.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Work order pertaining to the work done certificate uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder in his name, should have in the last five financial years (i.e 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26) achieved at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 16.68 Lakhs. In proof of this turnover certificate duly certified by a chartered accountant shall be furnished. (A Weightage of 10 % per year is applicable to previous annual turnover to bring them to current year price level )
